It iterates over the vertices of the polygon, adding the product of the x-coordinate of the current vertex and the y-coordinate of the next vertex, and subtracting the product of the x-coordinate of the next vertex and the y-coordinate of the current vertex. The result is divided by 2 to get the final area. 

The function handles edge cases by using the modulo operator to wrap around to the start of the polygon when reaching the end, ensuring that all vertices are considered. 

The function returns the signed area, which is positive if the polygon is oriented counterclockwise and negative if it is oriented clockwise.
